note: A card is a QUESTION with a named record that would settle it. Nothing here is a finding. Status stays HYPOTHESIS until a primary document is ingested and cited.

cards.title: Gahanna tax-incentive review: was the quorum problem corrected?
pair: the review body's own meeting record
cards.basis: Reported by the operator from a research packet: a city attorney memo identified a quorum problem in the incentive review process. The memo itself has NOT been ingested or read by this desk.
cards.question: Did the review body that examines Gahanna's tax-incentive agreements meet with a quorum when it acted, and if a defect existed, how and when did the city correct it?

records.what: The city attorney memo (the document that raises the quorum issue)
records.custodian: City of Gahanna, Law Director / Clerk of Council
records.route: R.C. 149.43 request (attorney-client privilege may be asserted; ask for any portion that is not privileged, and note a memo already in a public packet is public)

records.what: Review council notices, rosters, attendance and certified minutes for each year at issue
records.custodian: City of Gahanna, Clerk of Council / Finance

records.what: Any resolution, re-vote or ratification after the memo
The list of active incentive agreements and their annual reports
records.custodian: Gahanna Finance / Economic Development; Franklin County Auditor

statutes_to_verify: The Ohio statute that creates the tax incentive review council and sets its membership and annual-meeting duties (retrieve the current text; do not cite from memory)
cards.settling_document: Certified minutes showing members present and the action taken, plus any later corrective resolution with its date.
cards.innocent_explanation: The defect was noticed, the body re-met or ratified its actions, and the record simply sits in minutes nobody has read.
cards.kill_condition: Minutes show a quorum at every action, or a dated corrective action covering the affected years.
cards.publication_gate: Names a municipality and its officials: send a right-of-reply request to the city before anything is published.

cards.title: Federal contract amendments against what was actually paid
cards.basis: Method card. Applies to any award already captured (USAspending).
cards.question: For one award, how do the base value, the sum of its modifications, the potential value and the outlays compare, and does any modification add scope without a matching statement of work change?

records.what: Award transaction history (every modification, with action date and obligation)
The modification documents (SF-30) and statement of work
records.route: FOIA (federal); ask for the SF-30s by award ID
FOIA; expect exemption claims, ask for segregable portions

cards.settling_document: The SF-30 for the modification in question and the agency's invoice or payment record for the same period.
cards.innocent_explanation: Modifications routinely extend period of performance, add options or fund incremental work; growth in obligation is normal.
cards.kill_condition: Each modification maps to a stated scope change and outlays do not exceed obligations.
cards.publication_gate: Obligated plus potential is not cash paid. Delivery orders under one IDIQ are never added to the IDIQ.

cards.title: Promised jobs against reported jobs for a local abatement
cards.basis: Method card, aimed at the Ohio data-center and abatement threads already in the desk.
cards.question: What jobs, wages and investment did the agreement promise, what did the recipient report afterwards, and who checked?

records.what: The executed incentive agreement with its job and investment covenants
records.custodian: The municipality or county that granted it

records.what: Annual compliance reports filed by the recipient
records.custodian: Granting body and the state development agency

records.what: The review body's minutes on that agreement

statutes_to_verify: The statute governing the abatement type used (retrieve current text)
cards.settling_document: The agreement's covenant page set beside the recipient's filed annual report for the same year.
cards.innocent_explanation: Construction-phase jobs differ from operating jobs, data centers employ few people by design, and covenants may be written for investment rather than headcount.
cards.kill_condition: The covenant promises no jobs, or the filed report meets it.
cards.publication_gate: Employer payroll and withholding data are confidential; do not imply they were checked.

cards.title: A utility or large-load agreement against the public vote that approved it
cards.basis: Method card, aimed at the AEP / PUCO tariff and local data-center threads.
cards.question: Does the executed agreement match what the public body voted on, and was it on an agenda with its attachments?

records.what: Docket filings: retrieve the case number from the PUCO docket search, do not recall it
Council or commission agenda packet, minutes and roll call
The executed agreement and any amendments
records.route: R.C. 149.43; utility filings in the docket

statutes_to_verify: Ohio open-meetings law, current text, for notice and agenda requirements
cards.settling_document: The executed agreement beside the approved ordinance or resolution and its roll call.
cards.innocent_explanation: Staff may be delegated authority to finalize terms; the packet may be posted under a different title.
cards.kill_condition: Executed terms equal the approved terms.
cards.publication_gate: Federal lobbying filings (LDA) do not show lobbying on state or local matters; do not infer it.

cards.title: A surveillance policy against its own audit log
cards.basis: The desk already holds Flock audit exports obtained under R.C. 149.43. The policy text must be ingested alongside them.
cards.question: What does the written policy require for each search (reason, case number, authorization, retention), and what share of logged searches carry the required fields?

records.what: Native audit logs with the search-reason and case-number fields
records.route: R.C. 149.43; do not request plate data

statutes_to_verify: Any Ohio statute or rule on ALPR data retention or access (retrieve current text)
cards.settling_document: The policy's required-field clause and the full audit export, counted field by field.
cards.innocent_explanation: The policy may not require the field, or the field may be optional in the vendor tool.
cards.kill_condition: The policy does not require it, or the field is populated in nearly all rows.
cards.publication_gate: State plainly that audit completeness cannot be answered from any register without the native log. Count from the export only; show numerator and denominator.
